The location is easy to find, in a residential area, with a spacious area where you can choose where you want to sit, including a seating area. They have a wide variety of food and drink menus. There's a prayer room that can accommodate up to 5 adults. I think the food is good, but nothing extraordinary; it's standard home-cooked food. Recommended for those of you who want to bring a large family. The price is relatively reasonable. The only downside, in my opinion, is that this place is full of mosquitoes, as it's right next to the swamp behind it.
